name: 28443 · Hampstead, NC
findings: ZIP 28443 (Hampstead) has 56 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 18 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28443 (Hampstead) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28443 (Hampstead) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 26 organizations here; 55% of all organizations here have no identified type.
